health.desc: Rolling per-account health score from recent request outcomes. Spots a degrading credential (auth/suspended/profile errors) before it hard-bans. Benign quota errors are excluded.
health.heuristicNote: Heuristic degradation score, not a validated ban predictor. AWS does not publish pre-ban signals; this scores observable failure patterns over the recent window.

settings.configRestoreConfirm: Restore the latest config backup? Current config will be backed up first.
settings.endpointFallbackHint: When disabled, only the selected endpoint is used without automatic fallback
settings.endpointHint: Select preferred endpoint. In auto-select mode, the endpoint is automatically selected based on availability.
settings.externalUsageAutoDisableHint: When enabled, an account is automatically disabled for local routing the first time it is confirmed to be used outside this proxy (strong external usage). Reversible: re-enable it in Accounts. Does not affect the upstream Kiro account.
settings.filterClaudeCode: Replace Claude Code CLI system prompts
settings.filterClaudeCodeHint: Detects Claude Code built-in system prompts and replaces them with a compact backend prompt.
settings.filterEnvNoiseHint: Removes injected env vars, git status, recent commits and similar noise from system prompts.
settings.filterPIIHint: Best-effort redaction of emails, SSNs, credit-card-like numbers, IPs, and API keys from the system prompt before it is sent upstream. May occasionally over-redact.
settings.filterStripBoundariesHint: Strips --- SYSTEM PROMPT --- / --- END SYSTEM PROMPT --- marker lines.
settings.metricsEnabledHint: Expose a public, unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics endpoint for scraping. Only aggregate operational gauges (no secrets). Enable only when the scrape path is protected by network policy.
settings.proxyHostRequired: Please enter proxy host and port
settings.quotaAwareRoutingHint: When enabled, requests are routed to the account with the most remaining period quota instead of blind round-robin. Falls back to round-robin when quota data is unavailable.
settings.responseCacheHint: Cache identical non-streaming, tool-free, non-thinking requests to save upstream credits. Exact-match only; off by default.
settings.thinkingSuffixHint: Add this suffix to model name to enable thinking mode, e.g. claude-sonnet-4.5-thinking
settings.webhookURLHint: Optional. When set, security/warning events (account banned, external usage detected, auto-disable) are POSTed to this URL (Slack/Discord-compatible). Only safe fields are sent — never tokens, secrets, or prompts. Leave empty to disable.
sso.step2: Press F12 to open DevTools → Application → Cookies
sso.tokenHint: *Supports batch import, one token per line

usageAudit.creditsNote: Measured in AWS agentic-request credits. There is no external token figure: upstream reports no token count for traffic this proxy did not originate, so "our tokens" covers only requests we served.
usageAudit.desc: Detects whether each account credential is used OUTSIDE this proxy (real Kiro IDE, another sharer). Compares upstream billing-period usage growth against the credits we metered in the same period.
usageAudit.noUpstream: No upstream usage data yet (refresh or recheck to establish a baseline).
usageAudit.title: Account Usage Audit
